item.title: How Much Of Your Salary Should Go To Rent? Here's The Math

ns0:content.ns0:description: Renters often choose properties based on headline rent without stress-testing it against their income.

item.description: As a rule of thumb, rent shouldn't exceed 30-40 per cent of monthly income; going beyond that materially strains cash flow and crowds out savings.
